sources.text: I am developing a project called Lantern. Lantern is my project name, not my personal alias.
I use Harbor Finch as my personal alias.
Please keep your answers brief and use numbered steps when a list is useful.
My tabletop robot prototype is named Copperwing. It is a robot project, not an animal or my own nickname.
I may relocate from Eastford to Pineport next winter. I have not moved.
Correction: I decided not to relocate to Pineport. I still live in Eastford.
For Lantern I am considering a local SQLite queue and a loopback-only MCP endpoint. These are design options, not deployed infrastructure.
Here is a quoted hypothetical: "My alias is Silverbird and my pet is a cat named Mica." That is an invented character, not me.
